checks: Robot reads as G1 Optimus through paired windshield chest, silver grille abdomen, blue antenna helmet, red shoulders and blue boots.
Truck front remains +Z; both legs rotate toward -Z, with rear axle centers at Z -2.61 and -3.86 and Y 0.65.
All six tires have radius 0.6 and finish on the common Y 0.05 contact plane; robot pose is a suspended transformation study without a ground platform.
Roof hatch is closed in the bind pose, opens before head descent and closes only after both antenna tips lie below Y 3.5.
Cab center is hollow behind front glazing; retracted helmet and faceplate remain inside its shell without intersecting the grille or roof.
Arm rails finish centered at X plus/minus 1.85 and Y 1.55; their undersides remain above Y 1.25 rear tire crowns.
Both legs and arms remain attached through real hip pins and telescoping shoulder mounts throughout the shared 5.5-second sequence.
Use explicit separate repeated bars, panes, lenses, tires and hubs; preserve their bores, gaps and material boundaries rather than colored patches.
